svg.title: FlashNext expert-cache capacity and miss-rate replay
svg.desc: All 476 capacity samples after excluding the first 512 Decode forwards of EACH turn, comparison with zero and 1024 exclusions, continuous piecewise exponential on 4-48 GiB, and absolute residuals. This cutoff is not proof of stationarity. Effective routed-expert capacity, not total VRAM or measured MTP performance.
svg.text: FlashNext: expert-cache capacity vs. miss rate
Exclude first 512 forwards per turn / 15,508 forwards / 7,443,840 expert selections

g.text: D. Piecewise residual at every sample

svg.text: Piecewise: 27 continuous segments / max error 0.0393 pp / max relative error 0.922%
Errors apply to this replay grid only. Connecting sampled points does not recover unsampled CDF steps. No extrapolation.
